h: IVD reportedly breaks silence after Blessing CEO's release, with a pointed message to critics
p: Relationship content creator IVD has reportedly reacted publicly following the release of Blessing CEO, sending a bold message to those who criticised them. Online reactions have been mixed.
more: The pair have been in the public eye for years over a long-running legal dispute.
Blessing CEO has said charges against IVD were dropped in December 2025.
